title: The determining role of Al addition on tribology properties and oxidation behavior at elevated temperatures of TiZrHfNb refractory high-entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by arc-melting in water-cooled copper crucible under a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere, overturned and re-melted at least five times, cast into a water-cooled copper mold, cold-rolled by an 80% reduction in thickness, and annealed at 1000°C for 30 min followed by water quenching
